newsitem.title: USA: Hightec shareholders looking to sell. [CORRECTED 16:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hightec shareholders looking to sell. [CORRECTED 16:52 GMT]

text.p: Hightec Inc said on Friday that its two major shareholders are seeing a buyer for their 95 percent stake in the company.
The two holders are Bonita, Calif.-based E.F.M. Venture Group and San Diego-based Complete Security Service Defined Benefits Trust, according to a company spokesman.

Hightec, which makes computerized systems that control hydraulic machines used in large-scale mills, has just about 8.0 million common shares outstanding, he said. (Company corrects shares outstanding figure)
